method: ENGINEERING native-touch supply navigation. Actual world grid, collision, Game.killEnemy-created pickups, magnet/collection and real animation frames are exercised. Starts, kills, suppressed encounters, resources, expiry and some blockers are arranged through the test handle. No ordinary mission, independent quality, physical-phone or enjoyment result.

checks: map supply action fits, plotting does not grant resources, collection is physical and held route stays stopped
explicit supply route bypasses a nearby unrecovered receiver without recovering or braking
no live supply and insufficient lifetime are reported honestly and leave mission routing available
expiry cancels an active held route without a reward or automatically walking to the next mission
map and manual movement stop supply navigation; mission selection releases its dynamic field
crouched supply arrival goes around low cover and reaches an actual collectible face
empty rifle advice names available backup and live supply action; restart clears dropped resources and fields
